C9000366.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 366 (The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds.; papers: Interior regularity of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C366_MAIN.statement: Theorem main: reduced absolute minimizers with bounded fidelity data have the three local C1,alpha crack models and locally finitely many global crack components.

C366_REDUCTION.statement: Proposition initial-reduction: the original finite-length minimizing pair is locally bounded and rectifiable without changing the original pair.

C366_DIRICHLET.statement: Lemma dirichlet-input: smooth exterior data admit bounded SBV Dirichlet minimizers with essential closure including the replacement boundary.

C366_PLANAR.statement: Proposition planar-facts: the cited compactness, connected-complement absolute minimality, growth, almost-everywhere arc regularity, classification, and epsilon-regularity facts apply in the original comparison class.

C366_ISOLATION.statement: Lemma compact-isolation encloses every bounded crack component in a separated compact piece of positive finite length.

C366_CLASSIFICATION.statement: Corollary classification follows from planar-facts, compact isolation, and compact-piece exclusion.

C366_WEAKL4.statement: Corollary weak-l4 follows from the regularity theorem and the cited absence-of-irregular-points equivalence, in the bounded-data comparison class.

C366_COMPACT.statement: Proposition compact-piece excludes positive-length separated compact pieces containing an entire local regular arc, under precisely the source hypotheses.

C366_PROJECTION.statement: Lemma compact-projection constructs the unique normalized whole-plane potential, finite-energy jump field, distributional field equations, and exterior derivative decay.

C366_SPLIT.statement: The compact cutoff product and extension glue in Sobolev spaces; f extends harmonically through A, G is distributionally divergence-free globally and obeys the source growth bound.

C366_TRANSLATION.statement: Lemma translated-comparison is admissible under finite-disk compact comparisons, has exact length cancellation and vanishing annular errors, and yields the displayed quadratic inequality without subtracting infinite energies.

C366_INTERACTION.statement: Lemma harmonic-interaction has justified distributional translation derivatives and absolutely convergent tails; harmonic minimality gives constancy for every independent jump variation.

C366_FLUX.statement: Projection removal uses only local L2 and divergence, arbitrary one-sided C1-arc tests measure the correctly oriented flux, and constant translated flux forces planar affine rigidity.

C366_REMOVAL.statement: Affine rigidity, subquadratic growth, q=p, and connectedness force both fields and then the original gradient to vanish; removing A is an admissible positive-length improvement.

C366_LOCAL_CORRELATION.statement: For compactly supported L2 e with curl supported in compact A and locally L2, globally divergence-free G with curl supported in closed B, the compact correlation integral G(x).e(x-t) is harmonic off B-A, with no growth or global L2 assumption on G.

C366_LOCAL_COMPARISON.statement: Exact finite-R cancellation of the projected potential gives the finite-translation inequality for compact correlations using only local L2 of G; the interaction is constant on the full allowed translation chamber. The source interaction equals this correlation under its growth hypothesis.
